findings: On-resume change detection compares sets of aggregate FolderDetailsCache records, not per-file content stamps. Same-size content edits or within-folder replacements preserving count/bytes need not produce an app-resume event; actual scan helper remains unread.

invalidateCaches launches database clear asynchronously in application scope without awaiting it. A caller can proceed to read/repopulate before that clear runs; concrete coroutine race not exercised.

FolderBatchUpdate performs read-modify-write updates and deletes/upserts in separate DAO calls, without a transaction across the batch. Serialized event collection helps within this listener but concurrent full refresh can interleave.
getMediaFromBuckets emits disjoint batches of five then twenty items, not cumulative snapshots; downstream collectors must append. Caller behavior remains unread.
Media discovery combines file-system and MediaStore paths, removes duplicate path strings and tests exists. Physical file identity is not checked in this portion.
cleanupGhostFolders is explicitly a no-op, narrowing earlier startup cleanup description: initialization invokes it but it currently performs no cleanup.
